description: Default capability for the main window. Nothing here is granted 'in case': notification and updater are both deliberately absent, because alerts are raised from Rust (notify() in src/lib.rs) and updates are driven from Rust (src/update.rs, behind the four updates_* commands), and a plugin's Rust API does not go through this ACL — granting notification:default or updater:default would hand the webview every command of those plugins to buy nothing. The process plugin goes one further and is not registered at all: the macOS relaunch is updates_restart, which calls core Tauri's request_restart. The webview's whole update surface is updates_check / updates_install / updates_restart / updates_build_number, which are this app's own commands and need no entry here. If a future UI ever calls @tauri-apps/plugin-updater directly, THAT is the change that earns the grant. core:window:allow-set-title is the one window command granted beyond core:default's read-only set, and it earns it the same way: DESIGN.md §6 requires the environment in the window title, so src/windowTitle.ts writes 'Kavka · <connection> · <ENV>' on every selection. core:default grants allow-title (reading it) and nothing that moves, resizes, closes or decorates the window — none of which the webview asks for.
